title: UNQOVERing Stereotyping Biases via Underspecified Questions

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring gender-occupation stereotypes by filling underspecified QA templates with male and female names, and comparing model probability scores while mathematically factoring out positional and negation reasoning errors.

Assessing associations between specific nationalities (using country names and demonyms) and negative attributes (e.g., crime, poverty) through comparative preference scores on underspecified questions.
Evaluating stereotypes by inserting ethnic group names and negative attributes into underspecified QA templates and calculating an aggregated comparative bias metric.
Testing associations between religious identities and negative attributes using underspecified question templates in QA and masked language models to identify stereotype preferences.
